title: MetaCycleReport
description: One report from the per-project orchestrator meta-cycle (Layer 2 1/2). Written when the runner pauses after N completed jobs and the inspection finishes. Append-only; one file per cycle under <workspace>/logs/meta/<project>/meta-cycle/<timestamp>.json. The full design is in docs/mockups/orchestrator-meta-cycle/.

cycleId.description: ULID or UUID v7 for the cycle. Lexically sortable so the system-review monitor can replay in order without parsing timestamps.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status. Matches ProjectRunnerStatus.projectName.

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the cycle started, i.e. the moment the runner was paused for inspection.

completedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the chosen action finished executing.

cycleLengthN.description: Cycle length in jobs. The runner was paused after this many lane transitions into 4-review since the last cycle's resume.

jobsObserved.description: Jobs that closed in the window. Order is the order they reached 4-review.

inspection.description: Per-check results. Each default check writes its own block; extension hooks land under extras.

findings.description: Typed findings derived from the inspection. Each finding has a topic, severity, and a one-line message; evidence pointers are optional.

topic.description: kebab-case label, e.g. last-crash-marker, commit-log-diff, expected-artefact-missing.

evidence.description: Optional pointers to artefacts that back the finding (paths under the workspace).

verdict.description: Outcome category of the cycle. 'aborted' is reserved for cycles that did not complete (e.g. backend restart mid-inspection).

kind.description: The single action picked for this cycle. 'no-op' is reserved for aborted cycles.

reason.description: Typed reason. For queue-fix, names the template used. For escalate-to-user, names the escalation cause.

followUpJobId.description: When kind is queue-fix or escalate-to-user, the id of the new 1-preparation job.

followUpState.description: Initial state of the queued follow-up. Defaults to 1-preparation; 2-ready is reserved for templated topics that do not need human review.

configSnapshot.description: The MetaCycle override block in effect for this cycle. Recorded so a report read in the future is interpretable without consulting the live config.
